author: macfarla
content:
Hi all, Q re error codes alignment for eth_call / eth_estimateGas / eth_createAccessList

I noticed the new rpc-compat fixtures from #938 and #939 landed yesterday (eth_call / eth_estimateGas / eth_createAccessList rejecting fork-inactive fields and blob fields without hashes). Does anyone know the status of the spec error codes discussion for these methods?

Both PRs say error codes are out of scope and defer them to #784 https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/784. But #784 only covers eth_sendRawTransaction so far, and the #650 error groups are only attached to the send methods. For the call methods, execute.yaml only declares code 3, and the catalog has no entry for “field not active at this fork” or “blob fee without hashes”.

The fixtures came from geth, so they assert -32000, and hive compares error.code. Besu rejects all 19 requests but returns -32602 (Invalid params, which is what we use for every invalid call parameter), so they all fail for us. From the #938 results, reth is in the same spot with -32003.

We’d rather not change codes until the spec settles them, especially as downstream users assert on our eth_estimateGas codes. 

The 19 fixtures, if useful:

eth_call: call-fork-inactive-{access-list,fee-fields-zero,priority-fee,blob-hashes,authorization-list}, call-blob-fee-without-hashes{,-before-cancun}, call-blob-fee-empty-blob-hashes, call-empty-blob-hashes
eth_estimateGas: estimate-fork-inactive-{access-list,fee-fields}, estimate-blob-fee-without-hashes{,-before-cancun}, estimate-empty-blob-hashes
eth_createAccessList: create-al-fork-inactive{,-fee-fields}, create-al-blob-fee-without-hashes{,-before-cancun}, create-al-empty-blob-hashes
